# Zephaniah Chapter 3 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ZEP_003_page_001.jpg

---

**3:9** "For then I-will-change [ehpokh] for-the-peoples [ammim] a-pure [berurah] lip [safah], to-call [liqro] all-of-them on-the-name of-YHWH, to-serve-him [le-ovdo] [with] one [echad] shoulder [shekhem]."

**3:17** "YHWH your-God [is] in-your-midst [be-qirbkekh], a-warrior [gibbor] who-saves [yoshia]; he-will-rejoice [yasis] over-you with-joy [be-simchah]; he-will-be-silent [yacharish] in-his-love [be-ahavato]; he-will-exult [yagil] over-you with-singing [be-rinnah]."

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Formal English rendering of Zephaniah 3.

*— LOGOS*
